messages:
luis-support: Heads-up — enterprise customer ACME reported a spike in JSON mode parse failures after last night's model rollout. They see a lot of "invalid JSON" errors and some 500s when our API tries to validate schema. Pasting sanitized sample and headers.
sara: thanks — can you drop the sample + request id? also which model and route? :eyes:
luis-support: sample body (sanitized):
```
{\n  "response": "{\"items\":[{\"id\":123,\"value\":\"foo\"}]}"\n}
```
route: /v1/generate.json-mode, model: rwd-open-3b-v2, request_id: req_0a1b2c, latency ~1.2s then 500 when parsing service validates.
devon: seeing nested-JSON-as-string causing parser to choke — looks like model returned stringified JSON inside a response field. Did rollout change system prompt or format enforcement?
mike: not in rollout notes. infra-bot: deploy-bot shows last deploy 2024-09-08 02:14 UTC (release/serve-3.4.1). Could be a model config change pushed separately.
oncall-bot: @devon assigned to incident INC-3921 (parse-failures-acme). SLA P1.
sara: repro steps from customer? can you share curl they used. luis-support: also share headers (auth + content-type).
luis-support: customer curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate.json-mode \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"prompt":"summarize items","schema_version":"2.1","allow_stringified":false}'
```
mike: two immediate asks: 1) get full trace for req_0a1b2c (trace id if available) 2) add a temporary metric/tag for parse_failure with route+model to filter rate.
devon: I can pull traces — asking runtime team to turn on DEBUG sampling for the route for next 30m. Will also check whether our response sanitizer accidentally double-encoded JSON when model output includes quotes.
sara: in parallel we should update observability: - add alert for parse_failure rate > 0.5% over 5m per-customer - dashboard widget showing top request_id samples - ensure PII redaction in sample logs before sending to ACME.
mike: agreed. On redaction: we currently redact tokens in request body but not in model output samples. We should add a redaction step when exporting examples to S3/obs that removes email/credit patterns. filing ticket INF-1182.
luis-support: forwarded sanitized sample + timing logs to ACME support thread. They said errors started ~22:10 UTC after they ran a batch job.
devon: I pulled the trace: model returned a string with escaped JSON (see trace snippet). The validation service expects top-level object with keys matching schema. Because response was a string, validator threw 422 -> then service tried to fetch attempt to reparse -> blob -> 500 on our side.
infra-bot: new metric emitted: parse_failure.count {route: "/v1/generate.json-mode", model: "rwd-open-3b-v2"}
mike: action items: 1) runtime fix: add a tolerant parser path that will attempt to un-stringify responses before strict validation (devon). 2) short-term mitigation: add an ergonomic error message and return 400 with examples for customers (sara). 3) observability: dashboard + alert (mike/infra). 4) communicate to ACME with repro steps and ask for sample batch items (luis-support).
devon: ETA on tolerant parser PR ~4h, will include unit tests for nested stringified JSON and update canary. Will also log a sample (redacted) and set sampling to 100% for failing requests for 1h.
sara: I'll draft an external message for ACME: explain we see stringified JSON from model, suggest they can set allow_stringified=true as temporary workaround, and we'll follow up with a fix. Will ping legal if we need to share more logs.
oncall-bot: @sara assigned. Incident status: investigating. SLA timer: 6h remaining.
mike: once PR lands, we'll run a small canary on dedicated infra for ACME to confirm no regressions. Also adding a dashboard tile: parse_failure ratio by customer, last 24h. infra-bot will retain 72h of raw samples for triage.
luis-support: thanks team. I'll keep ACME updated and post final notes here. If anyone finds this is widespread, escalate to eng-runtime. :heart:
